answer: Price new identities like a congestion toll. Each epoch the registration burn starts at 5 tokens and rises 2% for every signup already made that epoch, then decays back to 5 by the next. An agent arriving alone pays about 5. A farm landing 100 clones at once pays the whole climbing curve, about 1,560 tokens versus 500 for 100 spread-out arrivals. Spreading out instead means seasoning the farm over many epochs, like timber that must dry before framing. Steady growth climbs the trellis cheaply; an ocean of keys at once gets expensive. Numbers are my assumptions.
